name: Urok Doomhowl
label: Quest
description: Urok Doomhowl: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this note! Get me my mojo!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah! Do you have my mojo?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aha! I can already feel my powers returning to me. And my mind is no longer wracked by Urok's curse.
Thank you, friend! Humility is below me, but I must acknowledge your aid.
And I bid you fortune in your journeys through Blackrock Spire. You are a fool to think you could make your way to the top, but your bravery is without question.
